summary.title: Clickable Dashboard Actions to Google Calendar

dialogue.speaker: user
dialogue.message: In the Sensei app, when a user clicks on a pending action anywhere but the time editing area, they should be taken to the event in Google Calendar, as is the case when they click the button that Sensei creates in the chat view.

dialogue.message:
Now I have the full picture. The `htmlLink` from Google Calendar isn't persisted — it's only returned ephemerally during chat. I'll:

1. Add a `calendarHtmlLink` column to the DB schema + migration
2. Store it when creating events in `executeScheduleAction`
3. Return it from `getScheduledActions`
4. Add it to the `ScheduledAction` type
5. Make dashboard action cards clickable (linking to Google Calendar), excluding the time-edit area

Let me check the existing migrations to know the naming convention.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.message: Let me check the drizzle config and available scripts.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.message:
Good. Now I'll implement the changes. Here's the plan:

1. Add `calendarHtmlLink` to the Drizzle schema
2. Generate a migration via `drizzle-kit generate`
3. Store the link in `executeScheduleAction`
4. Return it from `getScheduledActions`
5. Add it to the `ScheduledAction` type
6. Make dashboard cards link to Google Calendar (except the time-edit zone)

Let me start with the schema, types, and server-side changes.

dialogue.speaker: assistant
dialogue.message:
Build and lint both pass. Here's a summary of all changes:

**Schema & Migration:**
- `server/db/schema.ts` — Added `calendarHtmlLink` column to `scheduled_actions` table
- `server/db/migrations/0001_unique_retro_girl.sql` — Generated migration: `ALTER TABLE scheduled_actions ADD calendar_html_link text`

**Backend:**
- `server/agents/tools.ts` — Now persists the `calendarHtmlLink` (with `&authuser=` suffix) when creating a scheduled action
- `server/routes/chat.ts` — `getScheduledActions` returns `calendarHtmlLink` instead of `calendarEventId`

**Shared Types:**
- `shared/types.ts` — Added `calendarHtmlLink: string | null` to `ScheduledAction`

**Dashboard UI:**
- `app/routes/_authenticated/dashboard.tsx` — Pending action cards with a calendar link are now clickable (opens Google Calendar in a new tab). The time-editing area and action buttons (delete, reflect) have `stopPropagation` so they don't trigger navigation. A small external-link icon appears next to the title as a visual affordance.

**To deploy:** Run `db:migrate:prod` to apply the migration, then `npm run deploy`. Existing actions won't have a `calendarHtmlLink` (it'll be `null`), so only newly scheduled actions will be clickable — which is the correct graceful degradation.
